record.field: v = payslip.version_id cnss_pat = abs(CNSS_PAT) if CNSS_PAT else 0 amo_pat = abs(AMO_PAT) if AMO_PAT else 0 alloc = abs(ALLOC_FAM) if ALLOC_FAM else 0 tfp = abs(TFP) if TFP else 0 cimr_pat = 0 if v and v.l10n_ma_affilie_cimr and v.l10n_ma_taux_cimr_patronal: cimr_pat = SBC * (v.l10n_ma_taux_cimr_patronal / 100.0) mut_pat = v.l10n_ma_mutuelle_patronal if v else 0 charges_pat = cnss_pat + amo_pat + alloc + tfp + cimr_pat + mut_pat result = SBG + charges_pat
